base.description: Choose a legal empty hex to summon Living Armor with 40 + Spell Power total HP. Sorcery rank strengthens the Spell Power term. Each cast creates an independent construct for 3 rounds, including this round. It has 75% physical damage reduction and takes double magical damage. The final creature starts wounded when necessary. Its blue appearance is visual only. Eligible duration extensions apply; Time Stop pauses its remaining lifetime. It disappears after combat and cannot become permanent troops.
